title: Great, quality wood salt and pepper shakers. Would look wonderful on any table in any home!
text: Great, quality wood salt and pepper shakers. Would look wonderful on any table in any home!. Quality made, attractive salt and pepper shaker. These make a great addition to any household and would make a terrific bridal shower or housewarming gift (or just a gift for yourself). I use these for more casual settings (although you could use them for everything) and I have received a load of compliments from family and friends on them since I started placing them on my table. On top of looking good, they perform excellently, grinding my peppercorns to perfection. I highly recommend them these to everyone who takes pride in how their table is set.

product_metadata.title: COLE & MASON Sherwood Forest Wood Pepper Grinder - Wooden Mill Includes Precision Mechanism, 6.5 inch
features: Machine cut carbon steel precision mechanism creates a smooth and even turn
Easily fill the pepper grinder by removing the top
Conveniently select between fine or coarse granules by adjusting the knob on top
Traditional 6.5 inch tall wooden design with premium balance and Weight
Lifetime Guarantee, hand wash with damp cloth, do not submerge
description: The Cole & mason 6.5 inch Sherwood forest salt and pepper mills set a sturdy traditional theme for your table. Made of solid stained wood and featuring hardened carbon steel millworks, the Sherwood forest twist mills will look and perform professionally for years to come. Adjust the grind by turning the top knob for fine or a coarse setting and the special slice-and-grind mechanism will extract maximum flavor from any peppercorns. Refilling is easy by unscrewing the top knob and lifting up on the top. Style, durability and dependability have been built into every Cole & mason Product since 1919 using the best materials and mechanisms; our products have been well-regarded by professional cooks and homemakers ever since. Count on Cole & mason to give your table pepper grinder a touch of class.
